description: Launch sites, rocket-stage drop zones and major weapons test or bombing ranges, curated from general knowledge for the SKYWATCH elimination check 'military_or_rocket_range'.
geometry_note: Every geometry is an APPROXIMATE circle (centre and radius in km), not a surveyed boundary. Radii of closed ranges are chosen to sit inside the real, irregular boundary; drop zones are rough estimates. 'confidence' rates the geometry (high / medium / low). 'diffuse' marks areas shared with unrelated land use, where being inside is only a caution, never an explanation. The list is not exhaustive: absence from it is not evidence that no military or space activity exists.

entries.name: Baikonur Cosmodrome
entries.note: Circle approximating the ~6,700 km2 leased territory around Tyuratam; pads are spread over ~90 km east-west.

entries.name: Baikonur downrange drop zones, Ulytau / Karaganda steppe
entries.note: First-stage and strap-on booster impact zones roughly 300-400 km north-east of the pads. Real zones are several separate ellipses; centre and size are an estimate from the launch azimuth.

entries.name: Baikonur downrange drop zones, western Altai (Charysh / Ust-Kan / Ust-Koksa)
entries.note: Second-stage impact area for Proton and Soyuz launches; inhabited mountain valleys, so presence inside does not by itself explain a feature.

entries.name: Baikonur downrange drop zones, eastern Altai (Choya / Turochak / Ulagan)
entries.note: Second-stage impact area near Lake Teletskoye; inhabited and forested, geometry estimated.

entries.name: Plesetsk Cosmodrome
entries.note: Launch complexes are spread north-south over tens of km around Mirny.

entries.name: Plesetsk drop zone, Koida (Mezen district)
entries.note: First-stage impact area for northbound launches on the White Sea coast tundra; position from memory, not from published zone coordinates.

entries.name: Plesetsk drop zones, Mezen / Pinega taiga
entries.note: Booster impact areas in Arkhangelsk Oblast for north-east azimuths; very approximate.

entries.name: Plesetsk drop zones, Komi Republic (Udora / Ust-Tsilma)
entries.note: Stage impact areas east of the cosmodrome; very approximate and partly inhabited.

entries.name: Vostochny Cosmodrome
entries.note: Near Tsiolkovsky, Amur Oblast.

entries.name: Vostochny drop zone, Zeya / Tynda districts
entries.note: First-stage impact area for northbound launches, estimated from the launch azimuth.

entries.name: Vostochny drop zones, Yakutia (Aldan / Vilyuy)
entries.note: Second-stage impact areas in central Yakutia; very approximate.

entries.name: Kapustin Yar test range
entries.note: Missile and rocket range east of Znamensk; the true range extends much further east into Kazakhstan.

entries.name: Ashuluk air-defence range
entries.note: Air-defence firing range in Astrakhan Oblast; position approximate.

entries.name: Sary Shagan test range
entries.note: Anti-missile test range west of Lake Balkhash (Priozersk on its eastern edge); the true range is larger and irregular.

entries.name: Semipalatinsk Test Site (the Polygon)
entries.note: Former Soviet nuclear test site (~18,000 km2) south-west of Kurchatov; circle inside an irregular boundary.

entries.name: Novaya Zemlya test site, Matochkin Shar (zone B)
entries.note: Underground nuclear test area along the strait.

entries.name: Novaya Zemlya test site, Sukhoy Nos (zone C)
entries.note: Atmospheric test area including the 1961 50 Mt test.

entries.name: Novaya Zemlya test site, Chyornaya Guba (zone A)
entries.note: Southern island test area.

entries.name: Kura missile impact range
entries.note: ICBM re-entry vehicle impact area on Kamchatka.

entries.name: Dombarovsky / Yasny launch base
entries.note: Silo field used for Dnepr launches; silos are dispersed.

entries.name: Jiuquan Satellite Launch Center
entries.note: Launch area in the Gobi; the wider Dongfeng / Dingxin military zone is larger.

entries.name: Jiuquan downrange drop zone, Alxa desert
entries.note: Booster and first-stage impact areas east-south-east of Jiuquan; estimated from launch azimuths.

entries.name: Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center
entries.note: Kelan County, Shanxi.

entries.name: Taiyuan downrange corridor (southern Shaanxi / north-west Hubei)
entries.note: First-stage debris from southbound launches has fallen in this populated mountain region; corridor is diffuse and poorly constrained.

entries.name: Xichang Satellite Launch Center
entries.note: Sichuan.

entries.name: Xichang downrange drop zone, eastern Guizhou
entries.note: Booster and first-stage debris regularly falls in counties such as Zhenyuan, Tianzhu and Fuquan; populated, diffuse.

entries.name: Xichang downrange drop zone, south-west Hunan
entries.note: Stage debris area (Suining / Hongjiang); populated, diffuse.

entries.name: Xichang downrange drop zone, southern Jiangxi
entries.note: Upper-stage and fairing debris area (Suichuan / Yudu); populated, diffuse.

entries.name: Wenchang Space Launch Site
entries.note: Hainan coast.

entries.name: Wenchang downrange booster zone, South China Sea
entries.note: Maritime impact area east of Hainan; no land surface, listed for completeness.

entries.name: Lop Nur test site, underground test area
entries.note: Shaft and tunnel test areas north-west of the dry lake.

entries.name: Lop Nur test site, atmospheric test area
entries.note: Ground zero of the 1964 test and later atmospheric tests.

entries.name: Nevada National Security Site
entries.note: Former Nevada Test Site; circle inscribed in a larger irregular boundary.

entries.name: Nevada Test and Training Range, north range
entries.note: Air Force range north-west of the NNSS; circle covers only its core.

entries.name: Tonopah Test Range
entries.note: Inside the NTTR north range.

entries.name: Groom Lake and eastern NTTR north range
entries.note: Restricted flight-test area.

entries.name: Nevada Test and Training Range, south range
entries.note: Air Force range overlapping the Desert National Wildlife Refuge.

entries.name: White Sands Missile Range, north
entries.note: Includes the Trinity site. The range is about 160 km north-south; three circles cover its core.

entries.name: White Sands Missile Range, centre
entries.note: Core of the range.

entries.name: White Sands Missile Range, south
entries.note: Overlaps the co-use area of White Sands National Park, where natural dune movement is also a cause.

entries.name: Dugway Proving Ground
entries.note: Chemical and biological defence test range, Utah.

entries.name: Utah Test and Training Range, north
entries.note: West of the Great Salt Lake; position approximate.

entries.name: Edwards Air Force Base
entries.note: Flight-test base with Rogers and Rosamond dry lakes; circle inside the boundary.

entries.name: Naval Air Weapons Station China Lake, north range
entries.note: Includes the Coso geothermal field, which is a separate conventional cause of thermal anomalies.

entries.name: Naval Air Weapons Station China Lake, south range
entries.note: Randsburg Wash / Mojave B ranges; position approximate.

entries.name: Fort Irwin National Training Center
entries.note: Army manoeuvre training area.

entries.name: Marine Corps Air Ground Combat Center Twentynine Palms
entries.note: Live-fire manoeuvre area.

entries.name: Chocolate Mountain Aerial Gunnery Range
entries.note: Elongated north-west to south-east; circle covers only part.

entries.name: Barry M. Goldwater Range, east
entries.note: Air-to-ground ranges south of Gila Bend; position approximate.

entries.name: Fallon Range Training Complex, Bravo-17
entries.note: Fairview Valley bombing range; position approximate.

entries.name: Vandenberg Space Force Base, north base
entries.note: Missile and space launch complexes north of the Santa Ynez River.

entries.name: Vandenberg Space Force Base, south base
entries.note: SLC-4 to SLC-8 area.

entries.name: Cape Canaveral and Kennedy Space Center
entries.note: Overlaps the Merritt Island National Wildlife Refuge.

entries.name: Wallops Flight Facility
entries.note: Wallops Island launch range.

entries.name: SpaceX Starbase, Boca Chica
entries.note: Launch and test site.

entries.name: Pacific Missile Range Facility, Barking Sands
entries.note: Kauai.

entries.name: Reagan Test Site, Kwajalein Atoll
entries.note: Missile impact and test range; mostly lagoon and ocean.

entries.name: Bikini Atoll nuclear test area
entries.note: 1946-1958 tests, including the Bravo crater.

entries.name: Enewetak Atoll nuclear test area
entries.note: 1948-1958 tests; craters and the Runit dome.

entries.name: Amchitka nuclear test area
entries.note: Three underground tests, 1965-1971.

entries.name: CFB Suffield training area
entries.note: Live-fire training block north of Medicine Hat; position approximate.

entries.name: Woomera Range Complex, range head
entries.note: Instrumented launch and test area near Lake Hart, north-west of Woomera village.

entries.name: Woomera Prohibited Area (wider zone)
entries.note: About 122,000 km2 shared with pastoral stations, opal fields and mines, so presence inside does not by itself explain a feature.

entries.name: Maralinga nuclear test site
entries.note: British tests 1956-1963.

entries.name: Emu Field nuclear test site
entries.note: Totem tests, 1953.

entries.name: Pokhran test range
entries.note: Nuclear test site inside a larger field firing range; villages such as Khetolai lie within a few km.

entries.name: Satish Dhawan Space Centre, Sriharikota
entries.note: Barrier island launch site.

entries.name: Ras Koh nuclear test site (Chagai-I)
entries.note: 1998 tunnel tests.

entries.name: Reggane nuclear test site (Hamoudia)
entries.note: Gerboise atmospheric tests, 1960-1961, south-west of Reggane.

entries.name: In Ekker nuclear test site (Taourirt Tan Afella)
entries.note: Underground tests 1961-1966.

entries.name: Hammaguir launch and test site
entries.note: Former French rocket range; position approximate.

entries.name: Mururoa Atoll nuclear test site
entries.note: French tests 1966-1996.

entries.name: Fangataufa Atoll nuclear test site
entries.note: French tests 1966-1996.

entries.name: Guiana Space Centre, Kourou
entries.note: Launch complexes north-west of Kourou.

entries.name: Punggye-ri nuclear test site
entries.note: Tunnel tests 2006-2017.

entries.name: Sohae Satellite Launching Station
entries.note: Tongchang-ri.

entries.name: Imam Khomeini Space Center, Semnan
entries.note: Launch complexes south-east of Semnan.

entries.name: Palmachim launch and test site
entries.note: Coastal air base and launch site.

entries.name: Tanegashima Space Center
entries.note: South-east tip of Tanegashima.

entries.name: Alcantara Launch Center
entries.note: Maranhao coast.

entries.name: Esrange Space Center
entries.note: Sounding-rocket and balloon base near Kiruna.

entries.name: Esrange rocket impact area
entries.note: Sounding-rocket impact zones north of the base, shared with reindeer herding; approximate.
